purpose: Every effectful call site in greg/, foundry/systems/ and the repository modules they import (a child process, a stdlib call that starts one, an outbound connection, a name lookup, an inbound listener, code run from a string, an effect module handed out as a value, and every caller of a declared wrapper), keyed by module, enclosing qualname and callee with an occurrence count, what governs it and a pin binding its text to the code; and every place that code picks a program by name, with what it searches. Read by tests/unit/test_effect_call_allowlist.py; a site or lookup missing here, an entry with no site, a wrong count or a stale pin fails it. Listing a site authorizes nothing: this is a review-time inventory, not a grant.
rule: allowed: the site is reached only through a registered capability's adapter (its manifest, signed mission scope and Gate), the confinement those adapters run behind (run_isolated, the worker envelope, the #26 relay and door), the supervised worker path, a founder-signed selection or command, or a command a person runs by hand (greg CLI, installer, python -m harness, CI audit). known_unmediated: the body reaches the site on its own schedule (body-loop:) with none of those behind it; each is a finding, kept so it cannot grow silently, not an approval, and the test's FINDINGS names each one. wrappers: in-tree functions that pass an effect on with no check of their own; every call or reference to one is a site, keyed by the wrapper's dotted name, unless it keeps the wrapper's exempt_when keywords at their literal. pin: the sha256 the test prints for the code an entry's text describes (the whole definition for known_unmediated, the calls at the site for allowed); re-pin only after re-reading the text. path_lookups: where a program is chosen by name and what is searched; a program found on the ambient PATH is whatever file of that name comes first in a directory the body inherited.
